entities.summary: Glòria Comerma Broto is a Spanish field hockey player from Terrassa who plays as an attacker for Spanish club Egara, for which her sister, Anna Comerma, also plays. She has also played 23 times for Spain women's national field hockey team. Along with her hockey career, she is studying marketing at a university. Some of her hobbies are playing padel and tennis.
